summary: This bill requires the Secretaries of Health and Human Services and Labor to review existing grant programs supporting the nursing workforce and recommend changes to increase nurse faculty, facilitate experienced nurses becoming faculty, and encourage licensed practical nurses to become registered nurses.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly addresses the nursing workforce by requiring a study and recommendations for grant programs to increase nurse faculty and the nursing pipeline. This aims to improve the availability and quality of healthcare services, which broadly supports public healthcare access.
